category_title: Students exhibiting severe emotional behavioural difficulties (EBD)
scenario_title: Managing acute behavioral escalation and physical aggression in the regular classroom
minimal_context: The student is participating in regular classroom work with the whole class and is expected to complete an independent reading assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, please open your textbooks to page 42 and complete the reading assignment quietly at your desks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to read this. Everyone is staring at me like there is something different about me. I don't feel like I am part of the group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at the book and try your best to read it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts acting out and pacing around the classroom) I'm not doing it! I hate this!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down and be quiet, I need to help the other students right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Suddenly hits another pupil severely who is sitting nearby) Get away from me!
